name: Exponential Heun 2 (x0)
plain: Thin preset of the SEEDS-2 code with r=1 and no noise, giving a deterministic exponential Heun method working on x0 in logSNR. The second model call is made at the next sigma rather than a midpoint. Two calls per step like Heun.
math:
Symbols: x current latent; σ=sigmas[i]; σ'=sigmas[i+1]; D=denoised (x0 prediction after CFG); U=uncond_denoised; d=(x−D)/σ. 
λ=half-logSNR, h=λ(σ')−λ(σ), α=σe^{λ}.
x₂=(σ'/σ)x−α'·(e^{−h}−1)·D, D₂=model(x₂,σ').
b₂=(e^{−h}−1+h)/(−h) [ei_h_phi_2(−h)/r, r=1]; b₁=(e^{−h}−1)−b₂; x'=(σ'/σ)x−α'(b₁D+b₂D₂).

props.flow_const: Half-logSNR via sigma_to_half_log_snr (logit on CONST) with first σ≥1 offset to percent_to_sigma(1e-4).

providers.author: Comfy Org and contributors
providers.note: SamplerSEEDS2 reaches the same settings: solver_type=phi_2, r=1, eta=0.
